response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (14+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js/React exposure, direct current experience in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, and a track record spanning startups to enterprise data platforms. He exceeds the seniority bar and required technical breadth, though explicit Nest.js, Vitest, and Kotlin experience aren't confirmed, and his background leans toward polyglot/systems work (D, C++) rather than deep specialization in the exact primary stack.
strengths: 14+ years of full-stack experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems, far exceeding the 6+ year requirement
Current hands-on work with AI agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly matching a required skill
Demonstrated architecture and platform ownership (founder of GISCollective, staff-level roles) plus strong testing/TDD culture
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Playwright, which are core to the primary stack
Heavy use of niche languages (DLang) may indicate less recent deep focus on the TypeScript/Node ecosystem specified
No clear evidence of Kotlin experience, only Java, for the secondary backend stack

key_factors.factor: Gaps in exact primary stack tools (Nest.js, Vitest)
